title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 13, MAT-MIC - EB.10
text: MELIUNIA, Hanaher Hilory, the name of an earth famous in the earliest ages of painting, being the only white of the great patrizes of antiquity; and, according to Piny's account, one of the three colours which while alone they performed all their works. From the description given of this earth it forms to be alu-minus, tolerably pure, and in a fate of minute di-vifon.
